title: Testing a continuous-variable noncontextuality inequality with a hybrid-encoded system
summary: Continuous-variable quantum systems are promising candidates for quantum computing and quantum information processing. It is widely known that quadrature measurements on Gaussian continuous-variable systems admit a noncontextual hidden-variable description. Here, we demonstrate that this description fails once the same Gaussian correlations are instead probed using Hadamard tests.
